_about: The green card renewal or replacement (I-90) packet (src/packet.py, src/card_renewal.py), per the I-90 Instructions (01/20/25): the G-28 and the I-90, then a copy of the current card (front and back) (or, if it was lost or never received, a government photo ID) and proof of any name change. No photos: USCIS takes them at the biometrics appointment. A conditional resident whose 2-year card is ending files the I-751 instead. The attorney approves titles and order.
title: I-90 application (green card renewal or replacement)
